capabilities: Render person notes as a force-directed graph with photo nodes
Position nodes by closeness score around a central "You" node
Open a person's note by clicking its node
Configure person-detection field, exclusions, edges, and clustering
disambiguation: Not the core Graph view of all vault notes; it only renders notes identified as people by frontmatter.
extras: README includes a privacy section: the plugin scans file paths and frontmatter only and makes no network requests. PNG export exists; SVG export, tag/company filtering, and color themes are listed on the roadmap.
problem: Obsidian's graph view shows all notes uniformly as text nodes, so there is no way to visualize a personal network of people with relationship edges, closeness, and company grouping.
summary: Force-directed graph view that maps person notes as photo nodes with closeness-based positioning and company clustering.
